excerpt.zh: 我们应该指派一位总督来管理我们的新星域。星域中的所有£planet£行星将受益于总督的能力等级与特质。
excerpt.en: We should assign a Governor to administrate our new Sector. All £planet£ Planets within the sector will then benefit from the effects of the Governor's skill level and traits.
